items.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996
items.q: Young men in there like Bob Ojeda and people like that, Bob O. said, Man that was the reason I came over here in the first place...

ctx.x: Oh yes. Young men in there like Bob Ojeda and people like that, Bob O. said, Man that was the reason I came over here in the first place, I wanted to play this music that we’re playing now.” He said, “I love Frank.” He said, “I love Frank and I love Thad. But I came over here because I wanted to play this Basie music.” It’s back where he wanted it.
